## Summary
What problem is fixed? Link the issue or roadmap item.

## Setup and commands
List OS, Python/FFmpeg version, model and exact commands.

## QA checklist
- [ ] Ran local unit tests
- [ ] Verified actual alpha over black and white
- [ ] Kept complete character movement, checked timing
- [ ] Verified zero audio tracks
- [ ] Documented limits and error cases
- [ ] Confirmed input and dependency licensing / redistribution rights

## Artifacts
Link to *approved* sample output or describe how to reproduce; never publish private videos or access tokens.
